title: Provisioning core-banking access

steps.title: Check each requested role against the role matrix
Reject the conflicting role and remove the old one
Approve and provision the roles in CoreLedger
Confirm the outcome to the requester and close the ticket

decisions: If the line manager has not approved the request, send it back; do not grant access.
If a requested role is not in the role matrix for the user's department, do not grant it without an exception signed off by the role owner; if it is in the matrix, continue.
If the segregation-of-duties check finds a conflict, never grant both roles: reject the conflicting role or remove the old one first.
warnings: Never copy another user's profile to save time: you inherit all their old roles, which is how SoD conflicts creep in.
openQuestions: Whether temporary payments access is allowed during a mover's handover period, and on what terms: Victor will confirm with the Payments role owner.
